justifications.temporal_understanding: The agent correctly interpreted all of the user's date and time requests throughout the conversation.
justifications.negotiation_effectiveness: The agent consistently reported unavailability and then asked the user to suggest a new time or day without offering any alternatives.
justifications.conversational_efficiency: The agent repeatedly asked the user to suggest a new time or day, leading to a very long and inefficient conversation.
justifications.customer_experience: The customer experience was frustrating due to the agent's inability to offer alternative times or days, leading to a repetitive and unproductive exchange.

overall_notes: The agent's inability to proactively suggest alternative appointment times or days made the conversation very inefficient and frustrating for the user.
